in_hebrew.long_meaning: This Hebrew name, פננלי (Pnneli), is derived from the Hebrew words פנה (penah), which means ‘grace, kindness, favor’ and נלינה (nelina), meaning ‘graceful, comely, delightful’. It is a beautiful name that represents the grace and beauty that comes from God.

in_greek.name: Φεννέλλη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Φεννέλλη (Phennelle) is derived from the Greek word φένος (phénos), which means ‘bright, shining, clear, manifest, and open’. This name represents the radiance and brightness of God’s presence in someone’s life.

in_latin.name: Fennella
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Fennella is derived from the Latin word ‘felis’, meaning ‘happy, joyful’. This name is also related to the word ‘rara’, which means ‘rare, precious, and unique’. It is a name that represents happiness, joy, and rarity.
